name: io.github.paulneto/survey-agent
description: Agentic survey engine — author, stress-test, run, and analyze logic-gated surveys & screeners, and run one inline (begin_survey/answer_survey) to collect clean structured data from a human. The structured-elicitation primitive for agents.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Claude key for the agentic features (optional — an offline stub is used without one)

environmentVariables.name: SURVEY_LAUNCH_APPROVAL_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: If set, launch_survey is gated behind this human-supplied token
